predeclared_before: aggregation of any corrected flow's full SBC result

original_gate.definition: Every marginal KS p-value > 0.01 and every pair's original coverage deviation <= 0.10

holm_gate.definition: Holm-Bonferroni step-down across all three marginal KS p-values for every pair in a flow at family-wise alpha 0.01; pass if zero KS hypotheses are rejected and every pair's original coverage deviation is <= 0.10
holm_gate.coverage_rule: Unchanged from each original flow's SBC script

size_calibrated_gate.predeclared_before: restart of SBC blocks with independent case-index-derived RNG streams
size_calibrated_gate.definition: Test each pair's three marginal ranks with KS and each coverage level with an exact two-sided binomial test (per parameter for multi-drug, time-aware, and hierarchical flows; pooled across three parameters for continuous). Apply Holm-Bonferroni to the combined KS and coverage p-value family per flow at FWER 0.01; pass if no hypotheses are rejected.
size_calibrated_gate.original_coverage_tolerance_note: The 0.10 coverage tolerance remains unchanged in the original and Holm-KS gates; this gate uses exact binomial coverage p-values instead.

null_assumptions: Exact uniform marginal ranks; independent parameters and pairs; uniform location within posterior quantile gaps
